Torrents a debrid service fetched can be seeded in the built-in client or in your own qBittorrent, the desktop app keeps JDownloader out of sight and opens its window at once, and releases go to the browser and app stores on their own. Every change is listed in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

## ✨ Added

- **Seeding what a debrid service fetched, in the built-in client or in qBittorrent.** "Seed what the debrid service fetched" under Settings > Torrents seeds a torrent once all its files are here, without downloading anything. Every file is checked first, and for a `.torrent` file every piece. "Seed in" picks the built-in torrent client or an external qBittorrent, where cross-seed or qui find it. qBittorrent has to reach the files at the same path; "Download folder in qBittorrent" maps it when two containers mount the folder differently. ([#59](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/issues/59))
- **Only cached torrents to a debrid service, if you like.** With "Send only cached torrents to the debrid service" on, a torrent the service has not cached goes on to the next service or the built-in torrent client. TorBox and Premiumize.me are asked directly. Real-Debrid, AllDebrid and Debrid-Link get the torrent added, and KnightLoader deletes it there again unless it is ready within a few seconds. ([#59](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/issues/59))
- **A debrid service that stands still hands the torrent on.** After 10 minutes without progress, which you can change or turn off under Settings > Torrents, the torrent is deleted on the service and goes to the next service or the built-in torrent client. Downloads imported from the account and torrents pinned to a service are left alone. ([#59](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/issues/59))
- **Releases go to the stores on their own.** Once a release is out, the browser extension goes to the Chrome Web Store, Edge Add-ons and Firefox Add-ons, and the Android app to Google Play. Each goes only when it changed since the previous release.
- **An app bundle for Google Play**, `knightloader-v1.5.0-android.aab`, next to the APK and signed with the same key.
- **The other versions in the Android app.** Its settings have the Apps cards of the web interface: the desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux, Docker with a button that copies the `docker run` command, the source code, and the browser extension.
- **Unraid in the Android app and the README**, dimmed until KnightLoader is listed in Community Applications.
- **The privacy policy in the Android app**, linked from the About card.

## ⚡ Improved

- **Buy Me a Coffee in the app opens a window** with the appeal and the donation page, as the web interface does. PayPal still opens in the browser.
- **The tray icon is called the icon in the notification area**, in the module, its two switches and the hints that mention it.
- **A torrent taken up again to seed never downloads.** A finished torrent with a file missing or cut short stops seeding and says why on its row.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **Edge Add-ons accepts the browser extension.** The release carries two extension zips: `knightloader-extension.zip` for Chrome, Edge and the other Chromium browsers, and `knightloader-extension-firefox.zip` for Firefox.
- **The desktop app's JDownloader stays out of sight.** It opened its own window and update dialogs because it was not started headless. ([#58](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/issues/58))
- **The desktop app's window opens at once.** JDownloader starts in the background and joins when it is ready, instead of holding the window back for minutes on the first start. ([#58](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/issues/58))
- **No console windows on Windows** from Java, yt-dlp, ffmpeg or the programs set to run on events.
- **Closing the desktop app stops its JDownloader.**
- **A torrent starts even with a single seeder.** The torrent library could stay at 0 bytes next to a connected seeder; it is updated to the version that fixes this.
- **A torrent added to a debrid service at shutdown is still cleaned up.** Its job on the service was not saved and stayed on the account.
- **In the Android app:** a single file is "1 file", one instance found offers "Add this instance", an instance that comes back reads Connected again, and the About text says that the QR scanner from Google sends Google usage diagnostics.

## 🌐 Translations

- The new and renamed texts in all 42 languages, in the web interface and the app.
